verdict.rationale: Requesty is an LLM gateway, and operating such a product through natural-language commands is a reasonable thing for a buyer to ask about, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows it routing NL prompts to models and proxying third-party MCP servers for coding assistants. Nothing documents a natural-language interface, assistant or agent-facing tool for operating Requesty itself, such as configuring policies, keys or analytics.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
